description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate underwater aquarium decorations arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell, seen from the side as in a fish tank. Row 1: a low patch of colorful aquarium gravel, a soft mound of white sand, a pile of smooth round river stones, a big grey rock arch. Row 2: a mossy green rock, a twisted piece of driftwood, tall green seaweed strands, short red seaweed. Row 3: long wavy brown kelp ribbon, a clump of bright sea grass, a leafy aquatic fern, a round green moss ball. Side view, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no fish, no animals, no characters, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
